subject: Re: Tess <> Roger (Head of Partnerships at Encord)
text:
Hi Roger,

I can see that the team has kept you engaged over the past few days. Before
we finalize the referral pilot start date, I’d like to request a couple of
things:
*1. Sample datasets:* To support platform testing and client-facing demos,
we’d appreciate receiving small sample datasets (2–3 units each) for
different modalities (image, video, text, audio, DICOM or medical imaging,
3D LiDAR, etc). Having these readily available will allow us to demonstrate
platform capabilities more efficiently, without relying on client-provided
samples, which often require NDAs or DPAs and can delay the process.

*2. Holiday schedule & Pilot timeline:* Please note that our operations
will pause for the Christmas break from Mon-Dec 22, through Mon-Jan 5,
2026. Given that the pilot is scoped for 3 months and we’re already in
mid-October, with only 55 working days remaining in the year, I propose we
set Jan 31, 2026, as the official pilot end date. This will ensure we
account for the holiday period while maintaining a realistic timeline for
execution and evaluation.

Please let me know your thoughts. Otherwise, if the above request works on
your end, let's get this pilot engagement off the ground!

Best regards,

I was able to review the current capabilities of Encord's platform with my
teammates as needed.

   - For 2D, we will need to revisit the question of revamping the
   pipelines for that. Our current solution works for us at the moment, but
   once our engineering focus comes back to the 2D model training pipeline we
   would definitely want to reach back out to your team.
   - For 3D, we are hoping to explore more turnkey solutions which support
   auto-classification of individual point cloud scans over time (similar to
   the per-image classification in your 2D pipeline), and ideally gets us
   access to/is compatible with point cloud semantic segmentation models. I
   see Encord working for pending 3D classification needs we have, but likely
   not for the one we're currently prioritizing.

As such, I feel it’s not a fit for us right now, but we’d be open to
revisiting later this year. If you have any major developments in the 3D
space then, would love to explore those with you and see if it matches our
needs then.

Regards,
John
